arguments.code:
doc=App.getDocument("hook_lesson5")
s=doc.Spreadsheet
s.set("A8","opening"); s.set("B8","=45 mm"); s.setAlias("B8","opening")
s.set("B1","=2 * thickness + opening")
doc.recompute()
print([ (o.Name,o.State) for o in doc.Objects if 'Invalid' in o.State or 'Error' in str(o.State)])
b=doc.Body; sh=b.Shape
print("tip",b.Tip.Name,"solids",len(sh.Solids),"valid",sh.isValid(),"vol",sh.Volume,sh.BoundBox)
print("hook_depth",s.hook_depth,"opening",s.opening)
sk=doc.Sketch
for i,g in enumerate(sk.Geometry):print(i,g.StartPoint,g.EndPoint)
print("sketch solve",sk.solve())
import Part
# measure on final shape
bb=sh.BoundBox
print("plate height",bb.ZLength,"width",bb.YLength)
# cross-section at mid width y=-15
sec=sh.slice(App.Vector(0,1,0),-15.0)
for w in sec:
    print([ (round(v.X,3),round(v.Z,3)) for v in w.Vertexes])
# holes
for f in sh.Faces:
    if f.Surface.__class__.__name__=="Cylinder":
        print("cyl r",f.Surface.Radius,"axis",f.Surface.Axis,"center",f.Surface.Center, "com",f.CenterOfMass)
# fillet
fi=doc.Fillet
print("fillet radius",fi.Radius,fi.Base[1], fi.Shape.Volume, doc.Hole.Shape.Volume)
for e in sh.Edges:
    if e.Curve.__class__.__name__=="Circle" and abs(e.Curve.Radius-2)<1e-6 : print("r2 edge",e.Curve.Center,e.Curve.Axis, e.Length)
